title: Test-Negative Designs with Multiple Control Pathogens: Majority-Valid Identification and Rare-Count Inference
banked_reason: D0.5 delivered incremental below the field floor; the finite-intensity transfer, certified selector, and dependent minimax-equality headline remain unproved.
gap_reasons: The headline finite-intensity conclusion is not established: the proof of the load-bearing uniform Hausdorff continuity of the latent fibers merely asserts that a finite active-line subdivision handles determinant-zero and collapsed-polygon boundaries, without performing that analysis or proving lower semicontinuity there.

The subsequent claim that directed interval evaluation produces legal lower nets, neighborhood upper nets, and an algorithm guaranteed to terminate likewise supplies no explicit construction or certified uniform error, so the exact observed-data selector and equality L_n-V_{n,m_n}→0 remain unsupported.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 attempted an exact structural-fiber and six-Poisson decision-value theorem, plus a total honest selector and matched diverging-intensity rates. D0.5 found that the determinant-zero and dimension-changing fiber continuity argument and certified selector construction were asserted rather than proved; the dependent finite-intensity minimax equality is therefore unestablished, despite its "proved" label in core.json. The retained fiber, Poisson approximation, fixed-fiber LP setup, majority identity, and rate arguments need independent verification before reuse; this bank is a research record, not a sound finished paper.
tldr: Under the nonparametric Boyer-aligned assumptions of consistency, positivity, pathogen-specific multiplicative equi-confounding, and vaccine irrelevance, each valid pathogen contrast identifies the vaccinated causal log risk ratio; with at least two valid controls among three, their median identifies it without any binary-latent, common-loading, box, or rarity restriction. The sharper inference theory is deliberately scoped to the declared class \(\mathcal M_n\): there the exact latent fiber, abundant-multinomial plus six-Poisson limit experiment, certified finite-grid decision bounds, and exactly honest selector yield the finite-intensity minimax value, while the diverging-intensity regime has matched rates \(R_n\asymp(n\rho_n)^{-1}\) and \(L_n\asymp(n\rho_n)^{-1/2}\). The converse rate bounds also apply by subclass inclusion to any larger Boyer-aligned sparse class that contains the all-valid fixed-margin lower-alternative path.
gap: Boyer et al. derive pathogen-specific identification, pooled estimators, a shared-case Wald homogeneity test, and pairwise diagnostics, but their regular analysis does not determine honest inference when pathogen counts stay finite and the invalid control is unknown. General minimax expected-size and exact-discrete interval theory does not supply the structural fiber transfer from estimated abundant margins to the intersecting three-branch six-Poisson experiment.
fill: The project identifies the exact structural Poisson image, certifies its connected-interval game by convergent finite linear programs, and proves a uniform neighborhood-to-fiber value transfer with an exactly honest observed-data selector. This converts sparse multiplex control selection from an underpowered diagnostic problem into a sharp uncertainty benchmark.
